infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CloudySpaceGolf requires camera access to capture gaps in the clouds and confirm celestial positions.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Location is needed to calculate accurate local celestial coordinates and nearby gap alerts.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Motion sensors are used to align your phone reticle with stars and planets.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow CloudySpaceGolf to view the sky through cloud gaps.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow CloudySpaceGolf to use your location for celestial coordinates.
